authorization: User instructed completion of P2 preparation and start of P2 after the submitted2400-question proposal
source_frame: GSM8K official train; full official BBH test
quota_rule: Sorted semantic subtask names, first12 with capacity>=45 excluding penguins get45; others44
ordering: GSM first, then semantic BBH subtask order; each group ranks canonical hash using SHA256(seed|purpose|canonical)

duplicate_rules.exact: SHA256 of Unicode NFKC text with whitespace collapsed; no task/source prefix
duplicate_rules.token_equivalence: Ordered casefolded word/number/operator tokens match exactly; only punctuation/case formatting varies
duplicate_rules.critical_slots: Ordered numeric literals, quoted strings, capitalized word tokens, and math/logical operators must match
duplicate_rules.near_candidate_filter: same task and BBH subtask plus identical critical-slot signature
duplicate_rules.near_edges: Review candidates only; no union-find/transitive merging of pairwise similar texts
duplicate_rules.protected_comparison: Private HMAC slot gate, ordered-token equivalence, hashed character3-5gram count cosine>=.985, ordered-trigram ratio>=.985, word-token hash Jaccard>=.95
duplicate_rules.selection: Exclude all high-similarity review endpoints from text-ready proposals; do not count duplicate token-equivalence groups multiple times
duplicate_rules.limitations: High-threshold syntactic screening does not certify absence of semantic paraphrases. Sealed near-duplicate screening requires external precomputed signatures or separately authorized inputs.
